head_commit.message:
fix(core): bound early-exit output waits

Short-lived unified exec commands can exit before stdout is buffered. Waiting
until the full yield_time captures that output, but it also stalls silent
commands long enough to miss TaskComplete events in tests.

Use a small grace window after exit to pick up initial output without blocking
turn completion when there is nothing to read.
